# Magic Sport

> Magic Sport is a comprehensive compression wear manufacturer offering one-stop solutions for medical-grade stockings, athletic compression sleeves, and customizable apparel with sustainable materials.

Magic Sport specializes in compression socks, stockings, and sports apparel manufacturing with a focus on quality materials like Lycra, Bamboo Charcoal, and recycled yarn. The company provides full customization options, medical-grade products, and global shipping capabilities with OEKO-TEX certification standards.

## Key Topics

- Compression Stockings
- Medical-Grade Socks
- Lycra
- Bamboo Charcoal
- PET Recycled Yarn
- OEKO-TEX Standard 100
- One-Stop Service
- Custom Packaging
- Compression Pantyhose
- Athletic Compression Sleeves
- Diabetic Socks
- Denier Variations
- Knitting Production
- Quality Inspection
- Global Shipping

## Core Services & Solutions

- [ONE-STOP SERVICE](https://www.magicsport-tech.com/one-stop-service): Comprehensive compression socks service with Lycra, Bamboo Charcoal, and recycled yarn options for complete customization.

## Compression Stockings & Hosiery

- [Stockings](https://www.magicsport-tech.com/product-category/products/stockings): Compression stockings product catalog with denier variations from 30 to 140 for medical and athletic use.
- [Compression Pantyhose](https://www.magicsport-tech.com/product-category/products/stockings/pantyhose): Compression pantyhose products with multiple denier options including 30, 70, 120, and 140 denier variations.
- [Diabetic Socks](https://www.magicsport-tech.com/product-category/products/stockings/diabetic-socks): Medical diabetic socks with arch support and non-binding compression options for health-conscious consumers.

## Athletic Compression Wear

- [Compression Sleeves](https://www.magicsport-tech.com/product-category/products/stockings/sleeves-sports-stockings): Sports compression sleeves including ankle, arm, calf, and knee support products for athletic performance.
- [Sports Apparel](https://www.magicsport-tech.com/product-category/products/clothes): Sports apparel including yoga leggings and graphene slimming products for active lifestyle.

## Packaging & Customization

- [Custom Packaging](https://www.magicsport-tech.com/product-category/packaging/box): Custom packaging boxes including display, drawer, and hanger box options for branded product presentation.
